$comment: Implements spec 03 §6.1 (ranking policy: enabled, scope, by, ties, only_complete, show_on_report, show_out_of). Ranking is a policy rather than a pack constant; CBE packs declare it disabled by default.
title: Ranking policy
description: Whether and how positions are computed for a programme (spec 03 §6.1).

enabled.description: Off by default for CBE programmes; a school may enable it per report (spec 03 §6.1).

scope.description: The population a position is computed within, for example class_group (spec 03 §6.1).

by.description: The aggregate or aggregate field ranked on, for example kcse_mean_grade.points (spec 03 §6.1).

ties.description: Tie method: competition 1-2-2-4, dense 1-2-2-3, or a shared average position (spec 03 §6.1).

only_complete.description: When true, learners with incomplete results are listed but not ranked (spec 03 §6.1).

show_on_report.description: Whether the position is printed on the report card (spec 03 §6.1, §8.1).

show_out_of.description: Whether the report prints the position as N/M rather than N (spec 03 §6.1, §8.1 summary block).

then.description: An enabled policy must state the population, the value ranked on and the tie rule; otherwise a position cannot be explained (spec 03 §6.1).
